sections.content: *Hasta ahora* (so far) and *últimamente* (lately) look back over a stretch of time up to now, so they go with the *pretérito perfecto* too. You know *ya* and *todavía no* from Unit 2: they also say whether something has happened by now, and they keep the *pretérito perfecto*.

items.spanish: Hasta ahora hemos visto tres cuevas.
items.english: So far we have seen three caves.

items.spanish: Últimamente Meg ha comido mucha fruta.
items.english: Lately Meg has eaten a lot of fruit.

items.spanish: Ya hemos hablado con los vendedores.
items.english: We have already spoken to the sellers.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos probado la fruta.
items.english: We have not tried the fruit yet.

sections.content: *Hasta ahora* and *últimamente* describe a stretch of time, not one moment. You can add *no*: *Hasta ahora no hemos visto las cuevas.* (So far we have not seen the caves.)
